# Homepage icons

All vectors here were downloaded from the visible SVG Repo Phosphor Filled collection.
`sources.json` maps every symbol used on the homepage to its exact SVG Repo page and its
CC0-1.0 licence. Attribution is not required under the displayed CC0 licence; the source
records and original SVG Repo comments are retained for provenance.

The builder reads these vectors, removes fixed colours, and embeds `currentColor` symbols
in `index.html`. Icons share a 256-unit design grid and render at 22–24px. The brand favicon
is a code-drawn lettermark, not a third-party icon. Other pages keep their existing icons.
